approvedConvention: Preserve existing namespace; use stable semantic camelCase suffixes; keep dynamic values as parameters; share only when owner, consumer and parameter contract match.
rationale: Every entry is an explicit form/option/accessible-label sink in the same Admin material editor. The material name remains a dynamic parameter in image alt text.
limitations: Proposal only; no product or canonical index change.
The leading space in the checkbox text follows the DOM text node separator and should be preserved or normalized deliberately during extraction.
Admin remains a distinct owner from Configurator even where labels are textually identical.
